newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: BOK sells dollars again to boost won - dealers.
newsitem.headline: BOK sells dollars again to boost won - dealers.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea (BOK) intervened again in late morning trading on Monday to boost the won against the U.S. dollar, dealers said.
Dealers said the central bank sold dollars at around 824.60 won level on 11.21 a.m. (0221 GMT). This was the second intervention during the morning session.
A local bank dealer said the intervention had been expected due in part to importer deals due on Monday.
Dealers said the dollar could soar to the 826.00 won level without dollar sales by the BOK.
The central bank never says whether or not it has intervened.
